Do not move, add, erase, extend, reimagine, repaint architectural detail or invent a different view. Preserve the existing low warm sun at far left, exact light direction and shadows. Treatment A: Clear neutral coastal. Gently restrain the amber cast while retaining believable warm low-sun highlights. Clean and lucid, no HDR, teal tint, global darkening, grey whites, heavy sharpening or artificial texture.
